canonical_project: Bank of Communications (Jiaotong) Gui'an Data Center
notes: Gui'an New Area project filed/approved for establishment 2023-03; phase 1 main structure topped out 2025-01-10. Planned ~279 mu, ~RMB 5 bn investment, 10,000+ racks, 200,000+ servers. Capacity 60 MW = 10,000 racks x 6 kW (design, phase 1+).
